name: Extra Sutra Known (Sutra)
body:
A spiritual journey has led you to enlightenment in the form of a new sutra.

Choose: A sutra that you do not already know.

Benefit: You immediately learn that sutra. It does not count against the maximum number of sutras that you can know.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you gain this feat, you may select a new sutra to learn.
